utility.notes: Silicon Valley Power is the City of Santa Clara's own municipal electric utility, serving Santa Clara since 1896 and delivering 100% carbon-free power to residential customers. Santa Clara is not served by PG&E for electric delivery.

value.name: Silicon Valley Power (SVP)
value.notes: SVP is a vertically-integrated municipal utility (like Palo Alto's CPAU, Riverside Public Utilities, Burbank Water and Power, and Glendale Water and Power) — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA. Santa Clara is notably absent from Silicon Valley Clean Energy's 13-community member list, consistent with Santa Clara having its own municipal utility rather than being PG&E/SVCE territory.
